description: RLHF feedback: positive boosts importance (Oja's rule), negative decreases, correct updates content. Also the quarantine gate: 'pending' lists memories withheld from search because they came from untrusted text, 'promote' makes one retrievable, 'quarantine' withdraws one. The gate covers observations, episodes and errors — pick which with 'kind'.

action.description: Feedback type, or a quarantine transition: promote/quarantine flip one memory's retrievability; pending lists everything currently withheld, in three lists (quarantined, quarantined_episodes, quarantined_errors), each row tagged with its kind.

allow_secret.description: Refused when the text looks like a live credential (token, password, URL with embedded creds). Set true only for a false match — the text is then stored verbatim, in clear, and reachable by search, export and every client.

id.description: Target UUID for promote/quarantine when kind is episode or error. For kind=observation use observation_id.

kind.description: Which table promote/quarantine acts on. Default 'observation'. An import quarantines whatever carried a credential, and cuba_sync writes episodes and errors too: without the matching kind those rows would stay stored and permanently unreachable. Ignored by positive/negative/correct, and by pending, which always returns all three.

limit.description: Max rows for the 'pending' listing (default 20, max 200)

name: cuba_eco
